verbatim_text: The application seeking approval for the proposed change in control of the IA shall be filed with SEBI prior to filing the application with NCLT.

title: Submit Online Application within 15 Days of NCLT Order
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must submit an online application to SEBI for final approval within 15 days from the date of order of NCLT.
trigger: NCLT Order approving change in control
required_action: Submit an online application with SEBI within 15 days from the date of NCLT order, along with specified documents.
evidence: Online application submitted to SEBI and corresponding documentation.
source_circular: SEBI Master Circular for Investment Advisers, HO/38/12/11(2)2026-MIRSD-POD/I/4300/2026, dated February 06, 2026
verbatim_text: Within 15 days from the date of order of NCLT, the IA shall submit an online application in terms of clause 8.2 along with the following documents to SEBI for final approval:

title: Provide Documentation for Final Approval
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must provide specific documentation as part of their online application for final approval.
trigger: NCLT Order approving change in control
required_action: Provide the following documents: NCLT order, approved scheme, statement explaining modifications, and details of compliance with conditions/observations mentioned in in-principle approval.
evidence: Copies of NCLT order, approved scheme, statement, and details of compliance.
source_circular: SEBI Master Circular for Investment Advisers, HO/38/12/11(2)2026-MIRSD-POD/I/4300/2026, dated February 06, 2026
verbatim_text: a. Copy of the NCLT Order approving the scheme; b. Copy of the approved scheme; c. Statement explaining modifications, if any, in the approved scheme vis-à-vis the draft scheme and the reasons for the same; and d. Details of compliance with the conditions/ observations, if any, mentioned in the in-principle approval provided by SEBI.

title: No Change in Control from Immediate Relative Transfer
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) are not required to seek prior approval for shareholding transfer among immediate relatives.
trigger: Transfer of shareholding among immediate relatives
required_action: No need to seek prior approval or change in control notification.
evidence: Documentation showing the transfer was made among immediate relatives.
source_circular: SEBI Master Circular for Investment Advisers, HO/38/12/11(2)2026-MIRSD-POD/I/4300/2026, dated February 06, 2026
verbatim_text: a) Transfer of shareholding among immediate relatives shall not result into change in control. Immediate relative shall be construed as defined under Regulation 2(1)(l) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 which inter-alia includes any spouse of that person, or any parent, brother, sister or child of the person or of the spouse;

title: Change in Control from Non-Immediate Relative Transfer
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must seek prior approval and obtain fresh registration for shareholding transfer to non-immediate relatives.
trigger: Transfer of shareholding by way of transmission to a person other than an immediate relative
required_action: Seek prior approval from SEBI and obtain fresh registration in the name of legal heir/transferee.
evidence: Approval from SEBI, new registration documents.
source_circular: SEBI Master Circular for Investment Advisers, HO/38/12/11(2)2026-MIRSD-POD/I/4300/2026, dated February 06, 2026
verbatim_text: In case of an intermediary being a proprietary concern, the transfer or bequeathing of the business/capital by way of transmission to another person is a change in the legal formation or ownership and hence by the definition of change in control, such transmission or transfer shall be considered as change in control. The legal heir / transferee in such cases is required to obtain prior approval and thereafter fresh registration shall be obtained in the name of legal heir/transferee.

title: Obtain Prior Approval for Transfer of Ownership Interest in Partnership Firm
summary: Investment Advisers must obtain prior approval from SEBI before transferring ownership interest in a partnership firm with two partners.
trigger: Transfer of ownership interest in a partnership firm with two partners upon the death of one partner or induction of a new partner
required_action: Obtain prior approval from SEBI and fresh registration if necessary
evidence: Approval letter from SEBI, updated registration certificate
source_circular: SEBI Master Circular for Investment Advisers (HO/38/12/11(2)2026-MIRSD-POD/I/4300/2026, dated February 06, 2026)
verbatim_text: Where the partnership firm consists of two partners only, the same would stand as dissolved upon the death of one of the partners. However, if a new partner is inducted in the firm, then the same would be considered as a change in control, requiring fresh registration and prior approval of SEBI.

title: Obtain Prior Approval for Transmission of Ownership Interest in Partnership Firm
summary: Investment Advisers must obtain prior approval from SEBI before transmitting ownership interest to legal heirs in a partnership firm with a clause allowing such transmission.
trigger: Transmission of ownership interest to legal heirs under the terms of a partnership deed
required_action: Obtain prior approval from SEBI and fresh registration if necessary
evidence: Approval letter from SEBI, updated registration certificate
source_circular: SEBI Master Circular for Investment Advisers (HO/38/12/11(2)2026-MIRSD-POD/I/4300/2026, dated February 06, 2026)
verbatim_text: Where the partnership deed contains a clause that in case of death of a partner, the legal heir(s) of deceased partner be admitted, then the legal heir(s) may become the partner (s) of the partnership firm. In such scenario the partnership firm is reconstituted. Bequeathing of partnership right to legal heir(s) by way of transmission shall not be considered as change in control.

title: Ensure Incoming Entities/Shareholders Satisfy Fit and Proper Criteria
summary: Investment Advisers must ensure incoming entities or shareholders satisfy the fit and proper person criteria as stipulated in Schedule II of SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008.
trigger: Incoming entities or shareholders becoming part of controlling interest
required_action: Ensure incoming entities/shareholders satisfy fit and proper criteria
evidence: Fit and proper person certificate from the incoming entity/shareholder, relevant documentation
source_circular: SEBI Master Circular for Investment Advisers (HO/38/12/11(2)2026-MIRSD-POD/I/4300/2026, dated February 06, 2026)
verbatim_text: Incoming entities/ shareholders becoming part of controlling interest in the intermediary pursuant to transfer of shares from immediate relative /transmission of shares (immediate relative or not), need to satisfy the fit and proper person criteria stipulated in Schedule II of SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008.

title: Ensure Compliance with Advertisement Code
summary: Investment Advisers must ensure compliance with the advertisement code as prescribed.
trigger: Issuance of any form of communication that may influence investment decisions
required_action: Ensure all forms of communications comply with the advertisement code
evidence: Compliance report, records of all communications reviewed and approved by compliance officer
source_circular: SEBI Master Circular for Investment Advisers (HO/38/12/11(2)2026-MIRSD-POD/I/4300/2026, dated February 06, 2026)
verbatim_text: Investment Advisers shall ensure compliance with the advertisement code as prescribed below: Advertisement shall include all forms of communications, issued by or on behalf of IA, that may influence investment decisions of any investor or prospective investor. The forms of communications, to which the advertisement code shall be applicable, shall include pamphlets, circulars, brochures, notices, research reports or any other literature, document, information or material published, or designed for use in any publication or displays (such as newspaper, magazine, sign boards/hoardings at any location), in any electronic, wired or wireless communication (such as electronic mail, text messaging, messaging platforms, social media

title: Prohibition of Misleading Statements in Advertisements
summary: Investment Advisers must not include statements that are misleading, deceptive, or likely to mislead investors.
trigger: Issuing advertisements
required_action: Ensure all advertisements do not contain misleading, deceptive, or potentially misleading statements.
evidence: Internal records of advertisement review and approval process.
verbatim_text:
iii. Any misleading or deceptive testimonials.
iv. Statements which, directly or by implication or by omission, may
mislead the investor.
v. Any statement likely to be misunderstood or likely to disguise the
significance of the same or any other statement contained in the
advertisement.
vi. Any statement designed to exploit the lack of experience or
knowledge of the investors.

title: Prohibition of Exaggerated Statements in Advertisements
summary: Investment Advisers must not include exaggerated statements that are inconsistent with the nature and risk profile of the product.
trigger: Issuing advertisements
required_action: Ensure all advertisements do not contain exaggerated or unrelated statements to the product's nature, risk, and return profile.
evidence: Internal records of advertisement review and approval process.
verbatim_text:
vii. Any statement that is exaggerated or is inconsistent with or
unrelated to the nature and risk and return profile of the product.

title: Prohibition of Use of Complex Language in Advertisements
summary: Investment Advisers must not use extensive technical or legal terminology or complex language that may distract investors.
trigger: Issuing advertisements
required_action: Ensure all advertisements do not include excessive details, complex language, or technical terms that could distract investors.
evidence: Internal records of advertisement review and approval process.
verbatim_text:
viii. Extensive use of technical or legal terminology or complex language
and the inclusion of excessive details which may distract the
investors.

title: Prohibition of Free Report Reference Without Verification
summary: Investment Advisers must not reference reports, analyses, or services as free unless they are actually free and without condition.
trigger: Issuing advertisements
required_action: Ensure all references to free reports, analyses, or services are accurate and verified by the Past Risk and Return Verification Agency (PaRRVA).
evidence: Internal records of advertisement review and approval process.
verbatim_text:
ix. Reference to any report, analysis, or service as free, unless it
actually is free and without condition or obligation.

title: Prohibition of Assured Returns in Advertisements
summary: Investment Advisers must not imply any assured returns, minimum returns, target returns, or percentage accuracy in advertisements.
trigger: Issuing advertisements
required_action: Ensure all advertisements do not contain statements that give the impression of assured returns or risk-free investment advice.
evidence: Internal records of advertisement review and approval process.
verbatim_text:
The advertisement shall not imply any assured returns or minimum
returns or target return or percentage accuracy or service provision
till achievement of target returns or any other nomenclature that
gives the impression to the client that the investment advice is risk-
free and/or not susceptible to market risks and/or that it can generate
returns with any level of assurance.

title: Prohibition of Discrediting Other Advertisements or Intermediaries in Advertisements
summary: Investment Advisers must not discredit other advertisements or intermediaries, make unfair comparisons, or ascribe qualitative advantages over others.
trigger: Issuing advertisements
required_action: Ensure all advertisements do not contain statements that discredit other advertisements or intermediaries or make unfair comparisons.
evidence: Internal records of advertisement review and approval process.
verbatim_text:
xi. Any statement which directly or indirectly discredits other
advertisements or intermediaries or makes unfair comparisons or
ascribes any qualitative advantage over other intermediaries directly
or indirectly.

title: Prohibition of Reference to Past Performance Without Verification
summary: Investment Advisers must not reference past performance or risk-return metrics in advertisements unless they are verified by the Past Risk and Return Verification Agency (PaRRVA).
trigger: Issuing advertisements
required_action: Ensure all references to past performance or risk-return metrics are verified by PaRRVA before inclusion in advertisements.
evidence: Internal records of advertisement review and approval process, verification reports from PaRRVA.
verbatim_text:
xii. Reference to past performance or risk-return metrics in respect of
the services of Investment Adviser unless such risk-return metrics
are verified by Past Risk and Return Verification Agency (PaRRVA)

title: Prohibition of Use of Superlative Terms in Advertisements
summary: Investment Advisers must not use superlative terms such as 'Best', 'No. 1', etc., unless they are factual details of awards received from independent organizations.
trigger: Issuing advertisements
required_action: Ensure all advertisements do not contain superlative terms without factual basis, except for awards from independent organizations.
evidence: Internal records of advertisement review and approval process, documentation of awarded status from independent organizations.
verbatim_text:
xiii. Superlative terms such as “Best”, “No. 1”, Top Adviser, “Leading”,
“One of the best amongst market leaders”, etc. so as to provide any
endorsement of quality or standing of the IA. However, factual
details of awards received by the IA from independent organizations
may be included.

title: Prohibition of Use of SEBI Logo in Advertisements
summary: Investment Advisers must not use the SEBI logo in advertisements.
trigger: Issuing advertisements
required_action: Ensure all advertisements do not include the SEBI logo.
evidence: Internal records of advertisement review and approval process.
verbatim_text: xiv. Advertisements shall not include SEBI Logo.

title: Prior Approval for Advertisements from SEBI Recognized Supervisory Body
summary: Investment Advisers must obtain prior approval from a SEBI recognized supervisory body before issuing advertisements.
trigger: Issuing advertisements
required_action: Obtain prior approval from the SEBI recognized supervisory body for all advertisements.
evidence: Approval letter or document from the SEBI recognized supervisory body.
verbatim_text:
i. Prior approval for the advertisement/material shall be obtained from
SEBI recognized supervisory body.

title: Prohibition of Advertising During Suspension Period
summary: Investment Advisers must not issue advertisements during the period of suspension by SEBI or a SEBI recognized supervisory body.
trigger: Suspension by SEBI or a SEBI recognized supervisory body
required_action: Cease all advertising activities until the suspension is lifted.
evidence: Official notification of suspension from SEBI or a SEBI recognized supervisory body.
verbatim_text:
ii. In the event of suspension of any IA by SEBI and/or by SEBI
recognized supervisory body, the IA so suspended shall not issue
any advertisement either singly or jointly with any other IA, during
the period of suspension.

title: Prohibition of Engaging in Certain Schemes During Suspension Period
summary: Investment Advisers must not engage in games, leagues, schemes, competitions, etc. that involve distribution of prize monies, medals, gifts, etc., during the period of suspension by SEBI or a SEBI recognized supervisory body.
trigger: Suspension by SEBI or a SEBI recognized supervisory body
required_action: Cease all activities involving games, leagues, schemes, competitions, etc., that involve distribution of prize monies, medals, gifts, etc.
evidence: Official notification of suspension from SEBI or a SEBI recognized supervisory body.
verbatim_text:
iii. The IA/RA shall not engage in games, leagues, schemes,
competitions etc. which may involve distribution of prize monies,
medals, gifts, etc.

title: Prohibition of Advertising for Associated Agencies During Suspension Period
summary: Investment Advisers must not advertise on behalf of any other investment/research/consultancy agency associated with them during the period of suspension by SEBI or a SEBI recognized supervisory body.
trigger: Suspension by SEBI or a SEBI recognized supervisory body
required_action: Cease all advertising activities for associated agencies until the suspension is lifted.
evidence: Official notification of suspension from SEBI or a SEBI recognized supervisory body.
verbatim_text:
iv. These norms shall be applicable to any other
investment/research/consultancy agency associated with the IA
concerned and issuing advertisement wherein the IA has been
named in the advertisement.

title: Retention of Advertisement Copies for Five Years
summary: Investment Advisers must retain copies of advertisements for a period of five years.
trigger: Issuing advertisements
required_action: Maintain records of all advertisements issued over the past five years.
evidence: Internal records management system or physical storage of advertisement copies.
verbatim_text:
v. Copy of the advertisement shall be retained by IA for a period of five
years in terms of Regulation 19(2) of the IA Regulations.

title: Compliance with Additional Guidelines as May Be Issued
summary: Investment Advisers must comply with any additional guidelines issued by SEBI.
trigger: Issuance of new guidelines by SEBI
required_action: Adhere to and implement any additional guidelines issued by SEBI.
evidence: Internal records of compliance with newly issued guidelines.
verbatim_text: vi. Any additional guidelines as may

title: Retain Advertisement Copy for Five Years
summary: IA must retain a copy of the advertisement for five years.
trigger: Issuance of an advertisement
required_action: Retention of a copy of the advertisement
evidence: Retained copy of the advertisement
verbatim_text: v. Copy of the advertisement shall be retained by IA for a period of five years in terms of Regulation 19(2) of the IA Regulations.

title: Display Brand Name and Other Information Prominently
summary: IA must prominently display certain information related to its brand name, trade name, logo, registration number, address, compliance officer details, grievance officer details, and disclaimer.
trigger: Usage of the IA's brand name or trade name
required_action: Prominent display of required information
evidence: Screenshots or records of displayed information
verbatim_text: i. The information such as name of the IA as registered with SEBI, its logo, its registration number and its complete address with telephone numbers shall be prominently displayed on portal/web site, if any, notice board, display boards, advertisements, publications, know your client forms and client agreements. ii. The information such as name of the IA as registered with SEBI, its logo, its registration number, its complete address with telephone numbers, the name of the compliance officer, his telephone number and e-mail address, the name, telephone number and e-mail address of the grievance officer or the grievance redressal cell shall be displayed prominently in statements or reports or any other form of correspondence with the client. iii. Disclaimer that “Registration granted by SEBI, enlistment with BSE and certification from NISM in no way guarantee performance of the IA or provide any assurance of returns to investors” shall be mentioned on portal/web site, if any, notice board, display boards, advertisements, publications, know your client forms, client agreements, statements or reports or any other form of correspondence with the client.

title: Do Not Use SEBI Logo
summary: IA must not use the SEBI logo.
trigger: Usage of the IA's brand name or trade name
required_action: Avoid using the SEBI logo
evidence: No presence of SEBI logo in relevant documents and communications
verbatim_text: iv. SEBI logo shall not be used by IA.

title: Facilitate Mutual Fund Schemes Through Stock Exchange Infrastructure
summary: IA is allowed to use stock exchange infrastructure for purchasing and redeeming mutual fund units on behalf of clients.
trigger: Client request or market conditions
required_action: Use of stock exchange infrastructure for mutual fund transactions
evidence: Transaction records showing use of stock exchange infrastructure
verbatim_text: Registered IAs are allowed to use infrastructure of the recognized stock exchanges to purchase and redeem mutual fund units directly from Mutual Fund/Asset Management Companies on behalf of their clients, including direct plans.

title: Control Unauthenticated News Circulation
summary: IA must put in place internal controls and ensure employees do not circulate unverified information.
trigger: Circulation of unverified news or rumors
required_action: Implementation of proper internal code of conduct, employee training, and monitoring of online activities
evidence: Internal policies, training records, logs of online activity
verbatim_text: i. Proper internal code of conduct and controls should be put in place. ii. Employees/temporary staff/voluntary workers etc. employed/working in the Offices of market intermediaries do not encourage or circulate rumours or unverified information obtained from client, industry, any trade or any other sources without verification. iii. Access to Blogs/ Chat forums/Messenger sites etc. should either be restricted under supervision or access should not be allowed.

title: Maintain Logs of Online Activity
summary: IA must maintain logs for usage of blogs/chat forums/messenger sites.
trigger: Usage of online platforms by employees
required_action: Maintenance and retention of logs
evidence: Logs of online activity
verbatim_text: v. Logs for any usage of such Blogs/Chat forums/Messenger sites (called by any nomenclature) shall be treated as records and the same should be maintained as specified by the IA Regulations.

title: Forward Market Related News After Approval
summary: Investment Advisers must ensure that any market-related news received by employees is forwarded only after being approved by the Compliance Officer.
trigger: Receiving market related news in official or personal mail/blog
required_action: Forwarding of such news to the IA’s Compliance Officer for approval before forwarding it further
evidence: Approval logs and records of forwarded news items
verbatim_text: Employees should be directed that any market related news received by them either in their official mail/personal mail/blog or in any other manner, should be forwarded only after the same has been seen and approved by the IA’s Compliance Officer.

title: Do Not Outsource Core Business Activities
summary: Investment Advisers must not outsource core business activities or compliance functions.
trigger: Outsourcing of activities
required_action: Ensuring that core business activities and compliance functions are not outsourced
evidence: Internal policies and procedures for outsourcing, records of approved activities
verbatim_text: The intermediaries desirous of outsourcing their activities shall not, however, outsource their core business activities and compliance functions.

title: Report Suspicious Transactions to FIU
summary: Investment Advisers must report suspicious transactions or reports to the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) or any other competent authority.
trigger: Outsourcing of activities with third parties
required_action: Reporting suspicious transactions/reports to FIU or relevant authority
evidence: Reports and records submitted to FIU
verbatim_text: Reporting to Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) - The intermediaries shall be responsible for reporting of any suspicious transactions / reports to FIU or any other competent authority in respect of activities carried out by the third parties.

title: Use Centralized Fee Collection Mechanism
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must ensure clients pay fees through a designated platform administered by an ASB.
trigger: Fee collection mechanism is operational and optional for IAs and RAs
required_action: Clients shall pay fees to IAs/RAs, through a designated platform/portal administered by recognized Administration and Supervisory Body (ASB).
evidence: Records of fee payments made via the centralized mechanism.
verbatim_text: Under this mechanism, clients shall pay fees to IAs/RAs, through a designated platform/portal administered by recognized Administration and Supervisory Body (ASB).

title: Encourage Use of Centralized Fee Collection Mechanism
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must encourage their clients to use the centralized fee collection mechanism.
trigger: Centralized fee collection mechanism is operational and optional for IAs and RAs
required_action: Registered IAs and RAs shall encourage their clients to use this mechanism.
evidence: Documentation showing efforts made by IAs to promote the centralized mechanism.
verbatim_text: Registered IAs and RAs shall encourage their clients to use this mechanism.

title: Establish policies and procedures to avoid or manage conflicts of interest
summary: Develop internal policies, procedures, and a code of conduct for managing actual or potential conflicts of interest.
trigger: Active involvement of senior management is required.
required_action: Lay down policies and procedures to identify and avoid or manage conflicts of interest, develop an internal code of conduct, and ensure communication to all concerned.
evidence: Policies, procedures, and code of conduct documents, communications logs.
verbatim_text: i. lay down, with active involvement of senior management, policies and internal procedures to identify and avoid or to deal or manage actual or potential conflict of interest, develop an internal code of conduct governing operations and formulate standards of appropriate conduct in the performance of their activities, and ensure to communicate such policies, procedures and code to all concerned;

title: Maintain high standards of integrity
summary: Ensure that business operations are conducted with integrity.
trigger: At all times.
required_action: Maintain high standards of integrity in the conduct of their business.
evidence: Internal audit reports, compliance logs.
verbatim_text: ii. at all times maintain high standards of integrity in the conduct of their business;

title: Ensure fair treatment of clients and avoid discrimination
summary: Treat all clients fairly and not discriminate between them.
trigger: At all times.
required_action: Ensure fair treatment of their clients and not discriminate amongst them.
evidence: Client feedback, internal review reports.
verbatim_text: iii. ensure fair treatment of their clients and not discriminate amongst them;

title: Place client interest above personal interest
summary: Ensure that personal interests do not conflict with the duty to clients, and prioritize client interests in all advice, decisions, and transactions.
trigger: At all times.
required_action: Ensure that their personal interest does not at any time conflict with their duty to their clients, and ensure that the client’s interest always takes primacy in their advice, investment decisions, and transactions.
evidence: Client records, internal audit reports.
verbatim_text: iv. ensure that their personal interest does, at any time conflict with their duty to their clients and client’s interest always takes primacy in their advice, investment decisions and transactions;

title: Disclose potential conflicts of interest to clients
summary: Inform clients about possible sources or areas of conflict that may impair the ability to provide fair, objective, and unbiased services.
trigger: At all times.
required_action: Make appropriate disclosure to the clients of possible sources or potential areas of conflict of interest which would impair their ability to render fair, objective and unbiased services.
evidence: Client records, internal audit reports.
verbatim_text: v. make appropriate disclosure to the clients of possible source or potential areas of conflict of interest which would impair their ability to render fair, objective and unbiased services;

title: Implement measures to reduce opportunities for conflicts through information barriers
summary: Use prescriptive measures such as information barriers to prevent the flow of information between departments or units.
trigger: At all times.
required_action: Place appropriate restrictions on transactions in securities while handling a mandate of issuer or client in respect of such security so as to avoid any conflict, and use prescriptive measures such as information barriers.
evidence: Internal records, compliance logs.
verbatim_text: vi. endeavor to reduce opportunities for conflict through prescriptive measures such as through information barriers to block or hinder the flow of information from one department/unit to another, etc;

title: Prohibit dealing in securities while possessing material non-public information
summary: Do not deal in securities when in possession of material non-public information.
trigger: At all times.
required_action: Not deal in securities while in possession of material non published information.
evidence: Internal records, compliance logs.
verbatim_text: vii. not deal in securities while in possession of material non published information;

title: Prohibit communicating material non-public information to others when dealing on behalf of clients
summary: Do not communicate material non-public information while dealing in securities on behalf of others.
trigger: At all times.
required_action: Not communicate the material non published information while dealing in securities on behalf of others.
evidence: Internal records, compliance logs.
verbatim_text: viii. not to communicate the material non published information while dealing in securities on behalf of others;

title: Prohibit market manipulation and price influence
summary: Do not contribute to manipulating demand or supply of securities, nor influence prices.
trigger: At all times.
required_action: Not in any way contribute to manipulate the demand for or supply of securities in the market or to influence prices of securities.
evidence: Internal records, compliance logs.
verbatim_text: ix. not in any way contribute to manipulate the demand for or supply of securities in the market or to influence prices of securities;

title: Prohibit incentive structures that encourage unsuitable product sales
summary: Do not have an incentive structure that encourages the sale of products not suitable for clients based on their risk profile.
trigger: At all times.
required_action: Not have an incentive structure that encourages sale of products not suitting the risk profile of their clients.
evidence: Internal records, compliance logs.
verbatim_text: x. not have an incentive structure that encourages sale of products not suitting the risk profile of their clients;

title: Prohibit sharing client information for personal gain
summary: Do not share information received from clients or pertaining to them, obtained as a result of dealings, for personal interest.
trigger: At all times.
required_action: Not share information received from clients or pertaining to them, obtained as a result of their dealings, for their personal interest.
evidence: Internal records, compliance logs.
verbatim_text: xi. not have an incentive structure that encourages sale of products not suitting the risk profile of their clients;

title: Implement systems for conflict of interest management and review compliance periodically
summary: Put in place systems for implementation of guidelines, provide necessary guidance, and review compliance periodically.
trigger: At all times.
required_action: The Boards of intermediaries shall put in place systems for implementation of the aforementioned guidelines and provide necessary guidance enabling identification, elimination or management of conflict of interest situations. The Boards shall review the compliance of the above guidelines periodically.
evidence: Board meeting minutes, internal audit reports.
verbatim_text: The Boards of intermediaries shall put in place systems for implementation of the aforementioned guidelines and provide necessary guidance enabling identification, elimination or management of conflict of interest situations. The Boards shall review the compliance of the above guidelines periodically.

title: Comply with additional provisions from other SEBI circulars
summary: Comply with any additional provisions regarding dealing with conflicts of interest issued by SEBI.
trigger: At all times.
required_action: The said guidelines shall be in addition to the provisions, if any, contained in respective regulations/circulars issued by the Board from time to time regarding dealing with conflict of interest, in respect of intermediaries.
evidence: Internal records, compliance logs.
verbatim_text: The said guidelines shall be in addition to the provisions, if any, contained in respective regulations/circulars issued by the Board from time to time regarding dealing with conflict of interest, in respect of intermediaries.

title: Provide free access to securities market data for viewing and downloading
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must provide securities market data, as required by regulatory mandates, free of charge for both viewing and downloading in the format specified.
trigger: Data provided by various data sources in Indian securities markets pursuant to regulatory mandates for reporting and disclosure in public domain
required_action: Make available such data free of charge both for viewing as also for download in the format specified by regulatory mandate.
evidence: Records of data access logs, usage reports, and confirmation from users that they have accessed the data without cost.
source_circular: SEBI Master Circular HO/38/12/11(2)2026-MIRSD-POD/I/4300/2026, dated February 06, 2026
verbatim_text: 'As far as the data provided by various data sources in Indian securities markets pursuant to regulatory mandates for reporting and disclosure in public domain are concerned, such data should be made available to users, ‘free of charge’ both for ‘viewing’ the data as also for download in the format as specified by regulatory mandate for reporting, as well as their usage for the value addition purposes.'

title: Comply with Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Combating Financing of Terrorism (CFT) standards
summary: Investment Advisers must adhere to the guidelines on AML and CFT as per the Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 and its rules.
trigger: Regulatory mandates for securities market intermediaries
required_action: Refer to the specified circulars for AML and CFT guidelines.
evidence: Documentation of adherence to AML/CFT policies, training records, and reports on compliance checks.
source_circular: SEBI Master Circular HO/38/12/11(2)2026-MIRSD-POD/I/4300/2026, dated February 06, 2026
verbatim_text: 'IAs are advised to refer to the following circulars with respect to ‘Guidelines on Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Standards and Combating the Financing of Terrorism (CFT) /Obligations of Securities Market Intermediaries under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 and Rules framed there under’ : i. Master Circular issued on June 06, 2024 available at the following link: https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/master-circulars/jun-2024/guidelines-on-anti-money-laundering-aml-standards-and-combating-the-financing-of-terrorism-cft-obligations-of-securities-market-intermediaries-under-the-prevention-of-money-laundering-act-2002-a-_83942.html'

title: Comply with Know Your Client (KYC) norms for securities market intermediaries
summary: Investment Advisers must follow the KYC norms as per SEBI's guidelines.
trigger: Regulatory mandates for securities market intermediaries
required_action: Refer to specified circulars and upload KYC information to Central KYC records Registry (CKYCRR).
evidence: Documentation of KYC compliance, records of uploaded KYC information, and reports on compliance checks.
source_circular: SEBI Master Circular HO/38/12/11(2)2026-MIRSD-POD/I/4300/2026, dated February 06, 2026

title: Provide certified past performance data on specific request
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must provide past performance data certified by a member of ICAI/ICMAI to clients only upon specific client requests.
trigger: Specific client request for past performance data
required_action: Provide past performance data certified by a member of ICAI/ICMAI
evidence: Certified past performance data provided to the client
verbatim_text: a) IAs may provide past performance data certified by a member of ICAI/ICMAI to a client (including prospective client) only on specific request of such client;

title: Communicate past performance data one-to-one basis
summary: Investment Advisers must communicate certified past performance data to clients (including prospective clients) only on a one-to-one basis and not through public media or websites.
trigger: Providing past performance data to clients
required_action: Communicate past performance data directly to the client
evidence: Records of communication with each client
verbatim_text: b) Such past performance data shall be communicated to clients (including prospective clients) on a one-to-one basis and such past performance data shall not be made available to general public through public media/website of IA or any other mode.

title: Enroll with PaRRVA within three months post operationalization
summary: Investment Advisers must enroll with the Past Risk and Return Verification Agency (PaRRVA) within three months of its operationalization to continue providing certified past performance data.
trigger: Operationalization of PaRRVA
required_action: Enroll with PaRRVA
evidence: Confirmation of enrollment with PaRRVA
verbatim_text: c) IAs who wish to communicate certified past performance data to clients (including prospective clients) must enroll with PaRRVA within three months of its operationalization, else such IAs will not be able to communicate certified past performance data to clients post three months from the date of operationalization of PaRRVA.

title: Use verified risk and return metrics after PaRRVA operationalization
summary: Investment Advisers must use risk and return metrics verified by PaRRVA for advertising or providing past performance data post its operationalization.
trigger: Operationalization of PaRRVA
required_action: Use verified risk and return metrics
evidence: Verification reports from PaRRVA
verbatim_text: d) The applicable period for such past performance data shall be prior to the date of operationalization of PaRRVA. Accordingly, the performance for the period subsequent to the date of operationalisation of PaRRVA shall only be advertised or provided to client using risk and return metrics verified by PaRRVA.

title: Include disclaimer with past performance data
summary: Investment Advisers must include a specific disclaimer when communicating certified past performance data.
trigger: Providing certified past performance data to clients
required_action: Include the specified disclaimer with the past performance data
evidence: Records of disclaimers provided with past performance data
verbatim_text: e) Any communication of such past performance data shall be accompanied with the following disclaimer: 'The performance data presented herein are not verified by Past Risk and Return Verification Agency (PaRRVA) or any other agency recognized by SEBI for this purpose. The performance data presented herein may not be comparable to performance data of any other IA. Computation of the performance may vary across the industry. Users are requested to apply their due diligence before making investment decisions on the basis of the given past performance data. Past performance is no guarantee of future results. Investment in securities is subject to market risk. Registration with SEBI or enlistment'

title: Use PaRRVA verified risk and return metrics after operationalisation of PaRRVA
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must use only PaRRVA verified risk and return metrics in communications to clients after the two-year period from the date of operationalisation of PaRRVA.
trigger: After two years from the date of operationalisation of PaRRVA
required_action: Communicate/display only PaRRVA verified risk and return metrics in any communication to clients (including prospective clients).
evidence: Documentation showing compliance with PaRRVA verification process.
verbatim_text: After two years from the date of operationalisation of PaRRVA, IAs will be permitted to communicate/display only PaRRVA verified risk and return metrics and will not be permitted to use past performance data related to the period prior to the date of operationalisation of PaRRVA, in any communication to clients (including prospective clients).

title: Communicate certified past performance data using templates specified by IAASB
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must communicate certified past performance data in the templates specified by IAASB.
trigger: After two years from the date of operationalisation of PaRRVA
required_action: Use templates specified by IAASB to communicate certified past performance data.
evidence: Documentation showing compliance with template requirements.
verbatim_text: IAASB shall specify the templates in which the certified past performance data shall be communicated in consultation with Industry Standard Forums for IAs and SEBI.

title: Comply with enforcement actions for contravention of PaRRVA provisions
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must comply with enforcement actions, including summary proceedings, if they contravene the provisions related to PaRRVA.
trigger: Contravention of the provisions of paragraph 24(i) and 24(ii)
required_action: Comply with enforcement actions, including summary proceedings under Regulation 30A.(1)(c) of SEBI(Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008.
evidence: Documentation showing compliance with enforcement actions.
verbatim_text: Any contravention of the provisions of paragraph 24(i) and 24(ii) will make an entity liable for enforcement actions, including summary proceedings “under Regulation 30A.(1)( c) of SEBI(Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008 which states that a person found to have made claim(s) of return or performance in respect of or related to a security or securities, unless otherwise permitted by the Board to make such claim(s) shall be liable for summary proceedings.

title: Refer to circular on MITRA platform
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) are advised to refer to the circular on the Service platform for investors to trace inactive and unclaimed Mutual Fund folios-MITRA.
trigger: Not explicitly stated, but implied as a reference
required_action: Refer to the specified circulars.

title: Refer to circulars on Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF)
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) are advised to refer to the specified circulars regarding the Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF).
trigger: Not explicitly stated, but implied as a reference

verbatim_text: IAs are advised to refer to the following circulars with respect to Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF):

title: Adopt Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF)
summary: Implement the CSCRF as per SEBI guidelines.
trigger: As of April 30, 2025
required_action: Adopt and implement the CSCRF.
evidence: Documentation showing implementation of the framework.
verbatim_text: IAs are advised to refer to circular no. SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_CSC_EXT/P/CIR/2025/60 dated April 30, 2025 on ‘Clarifications to Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF) for SEBI Regulated Entities (REs).’

title: Use Standardised UPI IDs for Payment Collection
summary: Collect payments from investors using standardised, validated and exclusive UPI IDs.
trigger: As of June 11, 2025
required_action: Use standardised, validated and exclusive UPI IDs for payment collection from investors.
evidence: Documentation showing the use of UPI IDs.
verbatim_text: IAs are advised to refer to circular no. SEBI/HO/DEPA-II/DEPA-II_SRG/P/CIR/2025/86 dated June 11, 2025 on ‘Adoption of Standardised, Validated and Exclusive UPI IDs for Payment Collection by SEBI Registered Intermediaries from Investors.’

trigger: As of July 31, 2025

title: Submit periodic reports for half-yearly periods
summary: Investment Advisers must submit periodic reports to SEBI within 30 days from the end of each half-yearly period.
trigger: Half-yearly periods ending on September 30 and March 31
required_action: Submit periodic report in the specified format within 30 days from the end of each half-yearly period.
evidence: Periodic reports submitted to SEBI as per the specified format.
verbatim_text: IAs shall submit periodic report for half-yearly periods ending on September 30 and March 31 of every financial year, within 30 days from the end of the respective half-yearly period for which details are to be furnished.

title: No Assured Returns Declaration in Agreement
summary: Ensure that investment advisory services do not imply any assured returns.
trigger: When entering into an agreement with a client
required_action: Include a declaration from the Investment Adviser stating that it will not provide investment advice implying any assured returns or minimum returns, target return, percentage accuracy, or service provision till achievement of target returns.
evidence: Investment Advisory Agreement signed by both parties, including the declarations.
verbatim_text: b) Declaration from the Investment Adviser that: Investment Adviser shall not, in the course of performing its services to the client, hold out any investment advice implying any assured returns or minimum returns or target return or percentage accuracy or service provision till achievement of target returns or any other nomenclature that gives the impression to the client that the investment advice is risk-free and/or not susceptible to market risks and or that it can generate returns with any level of assurance.

title: Avoid giving the impression that investment advice is risk-free or not susceptible to market risks
summary: Do not mislead clients about the risk profile of investments.
trigger: Providing investment advice
required_action: Ensure all communications accurately reflect the risks involved in investments.
evidence: Client communication records and internal policies on risk disclosure.
verbatim_text: IAs shall not give any impression to the client that the investment advice is risk-free and/or not susceptible to market risks and or that it can generate returns with any level of assurance.

title: Specify fees under Investment Adviser Regulations and relevant circulars issued thereunder
summary: Clearly state the fees charged to clients.
trigger: Providing investment advice
required_action: Ensure that all fees are clearly specified in writing to clients.
evidence: Fee schedule and client agreement documents.
verbatim_text: Fees specified under Investment Adviser Regulations and relevant circulars issued thereunder. (to be specifically mentioned here)

title: Specify fees charged to the client
summary: Clearly state the fees charged to clients.
trigger: Providing investment advice
required_action: Ensure that all fees are clearly specified in writing to clients.
evidence: Fee schedule and client agreement documents.
verbatim_text: Fees charged to the client. (to be specifically mentioned here)

title: Describe in detail the services provided by the Investment Adviser
summary: Provide a detailed description of the services offered.
trigger: Providing investment advice
required_action: Ensure that all services are clearly described and communicated to clients.
evidence: Service agreement documents and client communication records.
verbatim_text: Scope of services: The services to be provided by the Investment Adviser to be described in detail. However, the same shall be subject to the activities permitted under the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013.

title: Act in a fiduciary capacity towards clients at all times
summary: Ensure that the Investment Adviser acts in the best interest of its clients.
trigger: Providing investment advice
required_action: Act with a fiduciary duty towards clients at all times.
evidence: Client communication records and internal policies on client protection.
verbatim_text: The Investment Adviser shall act in a fiduciary capacity towards its clients at all times.

title: Comply with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013 and its amendments, rules, circulars and notifications
summary: Ensure compliance with all relevant regulations.
trigger: Providing investment advice
required_action: Comply with all relevant regulations.
evidence: Regulatory compliance records and internal policies on regulatory adherence.
verbatim_text: Terms of compliance with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013 and its amendments, rules, circulars and notifications.

title: Comply with eligibility criteria as specified under the Investment Adviser Regulations at all times
summary: Ensure compliance with the eligibility criteria.
trigger: Providing investment advice
required_action: Comply with the eligibility criteria.
evidence: Eligibility certification and internal policies on regulatory adherence.
verbatim_text: Compliance with the eligibility criteria as specified under the Investment Adviser Regulations at all times.

title: Conduct risk assessment of clients including their risk capacity and risk aversion
summary: Assess the risk profile of clients.
trigger: Providing investment advice
required_action: Conduct a thorough risk assessment of clients.
evidence: Risk assessment reports and client communication records.
verbatim_text: Risk assessment procedure of client including their risk capacity and risk aversion.

title: Provide reports to clients on potential and current investments
summary: Regularly provide investment reports to clients.
trigger: Providing investment advice
required_action: Provide regular investment reports to clients.
evidence: Investment reports and client communication records.
verbatim_text: Providing reports to clients on potential and current investments.

title: Maintain records of client-wise KYC, risk assessment, analysis reports, suitability, terms and conditions document, related books of accounts, and a register containing list of clients with dated investment advice and its rationale
summary: Keep detailed records of all relevant information.
trigger: Providing investment advice
required_action: Maintain comprehensive records as specified.
evidence: Client records, analysis reports, and internal policies on record-keeping.
verbatim_text: Maintenance of records i.e. client-wise KYC, risk assessment, analysis reports of investment advice and suitability, terms and conditions document, related books of accounts and a register containing list of clients along with dated investment advice and its rationale in compliance with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013.

title: Abide by the Code of Conduct specified in the Third Schedule of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013
summary: Adhere to the Code of Conduct.
trigger: Providing investment advice
required_action: Comply with all provisions in the Code of Conduct.
evidence: Code of Conduct compliance records and internal policies on regulatory adherence.
verbatim_text: Undertaking to abide by the Code of Conduct as specified in the Third Schedule of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013.

title: Specify types of securities for investment advice
summary: Clearly specify the types of securities in which investment advice will be provided.
trigger: Providing investment advice
required_action: Specify the types of securities and agree on direct implementation if applicable.
evidence: Investment advice documents and client agreement records.
verbatim_text: Types of securities in which investment advice would be provided, including an undertaking from the investment adviser to recommend direct implementation of advice i.e. through direct schemes/direct codes, and other client specifications / restrictions on investments, if any.

title: Provide details regarding financial plan or model as agreed with the client
summary: Provide a detailed financial plan or model to clients.
trigger: Providing investment advice
required_action: Provide a detailed financial plan or model based on risk profiling, total AUA of the client, and time period for deployment.
evidence: Financial plan documents and client agreement records.
verbatim_text: Particulars regarding financial plan or model or strategy as agreed with the client (based on the risk profiling conducted for the client, total AUA of the client and time period for deployment).

title: Consider tax-related aspects in investment advice and fee structure
summary: Take into account tax implications when providing investment advice.
trigger: Providing investment advice
required_action: Ensure that all tax-related aspects are considered in the investment advice and fee structure.
evidence: Tax considerations documentation and client agreement records.
verbatim_text: Tax related aspects pertaining to investment advice and as applicable on the investment adviser’s fee.

title: Provide a detailed statement of risks associated with each type of investment
summary: Disclose all relevant risks associated with investments.
trigger: Providing investment advice
required_action: Provide a comprehensive risk disclosure for each type of investment.
evidence: Risk disclosure documents and client communication records.
verbatim_text: Risk Factors: A detailed statement of risks associated with each type of investment covering the standard risks associated with each type of investment in securities and investment products.

title: Specify minimum period for advisory services and provisions for renewal, if any
summary: Define the validity and renewal terms of advisory services.
trigger: Providing investment advice
required_action: Specify the minimum period and renewal terms for advisory services.
evidence: Service agreement documents and client communication records.
verbatim_text: Validity of advisory services: Minimum period if any, and provision for renewal, if any, along

title: Minimum Period for Advisory Services
summary: Investment Advisers must specify a minimum period for advisory services.
trigger: When entering into an agreement with a client
required_action: Specify the minimum period of advisory services and provision for renewal, if any, along with terms and conditions for such renewal.
evidence: Agreement document specifying the minimum period and terms of renewal.
verbatim_text: Validity of advisory services: Minimum period if any, and provision for renewal, if any, along with terms and conditions for such renewal.

title: Amendments to Agreement
summary: Investment Advisers must allow amendments to the agreement by mutual written consent.
trigger: When there is a need for amendment in the agreement
required_action: Allow amendments to the agreement by mutual written consent of the parties.
evidence: Amendment document signed by both parties.
verbatim_text: Amendments – The agreement may be amended by mutual written consent of the parties.

title: Termination of Agreement
summary: Investment Advisers must specify conditions for termination of the agreement.
trigger: When there is a need to terminate the agreement
required_action: Specify circumstances under which the agreement may be terminated, including voluntary/mandatory termination by the Investment Adviser or client, suspension/cancellation of registration by SEBI, and other actions taken by regulatory bodies.
evidence: Termination notice document from either party or SEBI.
verbatim_text:
Termination – This Agreement may be terminated under the following circumstances, namely-
a) Voluntary/ mandatory termination by the Investment Adviser.
b) Voluntary/ mandatory termination by the client.
c) Suspension/ Cancellation of registration of Investment Adviser by SEBI.
d) Any other action taken by other regulatory body/ Government authority.

title: Notification for Termination
summary: Investment Advisers must provide notice before terminating the agreement.
trigger: When voluntarily terminating the agreement
required_action: Provide 30 days prior written notice to the client and 30 days prior written notice to the Investment Adviser.
evidence: Notice of termination document sent to both parties.
verbatim_text: In case of a voluntary termination of the agreement, the client would be required to give a 30 days prior written notice while the Investment Adviser would be required to give a 30 days prior written notice.

title: Option for Termination on Suspension of Registration
summary: Investment Advisers must provide an option for termination if their registration is suspended.
trigger: When the Investment Adviser's registration is suspended
required_action: Provide the client with the option to terminate the agreement upon suspension of the certificate of registration.
evidence: Notice of termination document sent by the client.
verbatim_text: In case of suspension of the certificate of registration of the IA, the client may be provided with the option to terminate the agreement.

title: Implications of Amendments and Termination
summary: Investment Advisers must provide details on implications of amendments, termination, and assignment.
trigger: When amending or terminating the agreement
required_action: Provide detailed implications such as set off of fees received by the Investment Adviser, refund of fees, completion/termination of investment-in-progress, transition support obligations of the Investment Adviser, etc.
evidence: Amendment and termination document detailing the implications.
verbatim_text: Implications of Amendments and termination: The implications of Amendment, Termination and assignment, such as set off of fees received by the Investment Adviser, refund of fees, completion/termination of investment-in-progress, transition support obligations of the Investment Adviser, etc. shall also be provided in detail.

title: Disclosure of Related Party Relationships
summary: Investment Advisers must disclose their relationship with related parties.
trigger: When carrying out investment advisory activities
required_action: Clearly declare that they are carrying on their activities independently, at an arms-length basis with its related parties and make disclosures of conflicts to be made.
evidence: Disclosure document from the Investment Adviser.
verbatim_text: Relationship with related parties: The Investment Adviser to clearly declare that it is carrying on its activities independently, at an arms-length basis with its related parties. Disclosures of conflicts to be made.

title: Individuals Engaged in Other Activities
summary: Investment Advisers (individual) must maintain an arms-length relationship with other activities and not provide distribution services.
trigger: When engaging in investment advisory activities alongside other business activities
required_action: Represent to the client that they maintain an arms-length relationship between their activities as an investment adviser and other activities, and covenant that this arm’s length relationship shall be maintained throughout the tenure of advisory service; Represent that they shall not provide any distribution services; Represent that the family of an individual Investment Adviser shall not provide distribution services to the client advised by the individual Investment Adviser for securities and investment products; Represent that they shall not provide investment advisory services, for securities and investment products, to a client who is receiving distribution services from other family members.
evidence: Client agreement document detailing the arms-length relationship and no provision of distribution services.
verbatim_text:
The Investment Adviser (individual) to represent to the client that it maintains an arms-length relationship between its activities as an investment adviser and other activities and to covenant that this arm’s length relationship shall be maintained throughout the tenure of advisory service; In case of Investment Adviser who are individuals:
a) to represent that they shall not provide any distribution services.
b) to represent that the family of an individual Investment Adviser shall not provide distribution services to the client advised by the individual Investment Adviser, for securities and investment products.
c) to represent that they shall not provide investment advisory services, for securities and investment products, to a client who is receiving distribution services from other family members;

title: Non-Individuals Engaged in Other Activities
summary: Investment Advisers (non-individual) must not provide distribution or investment advisory services to their own clients.
trigger: When engaging in investment advisory activities alongside other business activities
required_action: Represent that they shall not provide any distribution services, for securities and investment products, either directly or through their group to an advisory client; Represent that they shall not provide investment advisory services, for securities and investment products, either directly or through their group to the distribution client.
evidence: Client agreement document detailing the no provision of distribution or investment advisory services.

title: Obtain Client Consent Before Actions
summary: Ensure all consents and permissions from the client are obtained before taking any actions related to securities or investment products.
trigger: Undertaking any action in relation to securities or investment products advised by the investment adviser
required_action: Obtain all necessary consents and permissions from the client prior to taking any actions.
evidence: Client consent forms or records of communication confirming consent.
verbatim_text: The investment adviser to ensure that it will take all consents and permissions from the client prior to undertaking any actions in relation to the securities or investment product advised by the investment adviser.

title: Do Not Seek Power of Attorney
summary: Decline to seek power of attorney or authorizations from clients for implementing investment advice.
trigger: Implementation of investment advice
required_action: Clearly declare that it shall not seek any power of attorney or authorizations from its clients.
evidence: Client records showing no power of attorney has been sought.
source_clause: 14. No right to seek Power of Attorney
verbatim_text: The Investment Adviser to clearly declare that it shall not seek any power of attorney or authorizations from its clients for implementation of investment advice.

title: Maintain Client Accounts and Data
summary: Be responsible for maintaining client accounts and data as mandated under SEBI regulations.
trigger: Client advisory service
required_action: Maintain client accounts and data in accordance with SEBI regulations.
evidence: Records of account maintenance, data management practices, and compliance reports.
verbatim_text: Investment Adviser shall be responsible for maintenance of client accounts and data as mandated under the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013.

title: Provide Fee Details in Agreement
summary: Specify details on fees for investment advice rendered, including payment methods and periodicity.
trigger: Issuing an agreement with a client
required_action: Attach a detailed fee schedule to the agreement and provide specific details on fees, payment modalities, and periodicity.
evidence: Copies of signed agreements with attached fee schedules.
verbatim_text: Provide specific details on the following: (i) The quantum and manner of payment of fees for investment advice rendered. (ii) Fee modalities and periodicity, by attaching a detailed fee schedule to the agreement; (iii) Illustration(s) on how the fee will be determined; (iv) whether payment to be made in advance; (v) type of documents evidencing receipt of payment of fee; (vi) Periodicity of billing with clear date and service period.

title: Accept Fees Through Traceable Methods Only
summary: Accept fees through traceable methods only, excluding cash deposits.
trigger: Receiving payment for investment advice
required_action: Accept fees via account payee crossed cheque, demand drafts, or direct credit to bank accounts using NEFT/RTGS/IMPS/UPI methods.
evidence: Bank statements or transaction records showing traceable fee payments.
verbatim_text: The payment of fees shall be through a mode which shows traceability of funds. Such modes may include account payee crossed cheque/ Demand Drafts or by way of direct credit to the bank accounts through NEFT/ RTGS/IMPS/ UPI or any other mode specified by SEBI from time to time. However, the fees shall not be accepted in cash.

title: Limit Liability for Client Losses
summary: State that the investment adviser will not incur liability due to client losses resulting from market fluctuations or underperformance.
trigger: Issuing an advisory service agreement
required_action: Clearly state in the agreement that the investment adviser shall not be liable for any loss suffered by the client due to market conditions, asset value fluctuations, or underperformance.
evidence: Copies of signed agreements with relevant clauses.
verbatim_text: The agreement to clearly state that the Investment Adviser shall not incur any liability by reason of any loss, which a client may suffer by reason of any depletion in the value of the assets under advice, which may result by reason of fluctuation in asset value, or by reason of non-performance or underperformance of the securities/funds or any other market conditions.

title: Make Adequate Representations and Covenants
summary: Provide adequate representations about qualifications, approvals, and maintain them throughout the advisory service.
trigger: Issuing an advisory service agreement
required_action: Make adequate and appropriate representations about qualifications of advisers, principal officers, persons associated with investment advice, receipt of all applicable approvals and consents, and covenant to maintain them throughout the validity of advisory service.
evidence: Records of compliance with regulatory requirements and ongoing maintenance of representations.
verbatim_text: Adequate and appropriate representations about qualifications of the adviser, principal officer, persons associated with the investment advice, receipt of all applicable approvals and consents (from regulatory / statutory bodies, third party consents, corporate approvals etc.) and covenant to maintain them throughout the validity of advisory service.

title: Provisions for Client Death/Disability
summary: Incorporate provisions in relation to continuation or termination of advisory services upon client's death/disability, succession, nomination, representation etc.
trigger: Client's death or disability
required_action: Include provisions for the continuation or termination of advisory services in case of client's death or disability, as well as related matters such as succession and nomination.
evidence: Copies of signed agreements with relevant clauses.
verbatim_text: Provisions in relation to continuation / termination of the advisory service in event of client's death / disability, succession, nomination, representation etc. to be incorporated.

title: Appoint Legal Heir for Continuation
summary: Appoint a legal heir, executor, trustee, or administrator in case of the investment adviser's death.
trigger: Investment adviser's death
required_action: Appoint one of its legal heirs, executor, trustee, or administrator to continue advisory services upon the adviser's death.
evidence: Appointment documents and records of communication confirming appointment.
source_clause: 21. Death or Disability of investment adviser (partially)
verbatim_text: Every individual investment adviser must appoint one of its legal heirs, executor, trustee, admi

title: Appointment of Obligor in Case of Death/Disability
summary: Investment Adviser must appoint a legal heir, executor, trustee, or administrator to act as the person-in-charge upon death/disability and disclose steps for client protection.
trigger: Death/Disability of investment adviser
required_action: Appointment of legal heir, executor, trustee, or administrator; disclosure of steps to protect clients' interests and resolve disputes.
evidence: Signed agreement with the appointed Obligor detailing their full name, PAN, contact details, and steps for client protection.
verbatim_text: Every individual investment adviser must appoint one of its legal heirs, executor, trustee, administrator of estate of the deceased (the “Obligor”) as the person-in-charge in the event of investment adviser’s death / disability. The agreement must set out the full name, PAN and contact details of such Obligor. The agreement must disclose the steps to be taken by the Obligor in the event of the above eventuality in order to ensure protection of interest of the clients and redressal of clients’ claims.

title: Dispute Resolution Mechanism
summary: Investment Adviser must have provisions for dispute resolution, including arbitration.
trigger: Existence of disputes or claims between IA and clients
required_action: Establishing a mechanism to resolve disputes, which may include arbitration as per SEBI regulations.
evidence: Documentation outlining the dispute resolution process, including any agreements with arbitrators or arbitration bodies.
verbatim_text: Adequate provisions to cover protection of acts done in good faith as well as for dispute resolution mechanism including arbitration that may be specified under the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013.

title: Payment Acceptance Policy

In the event of equipment breakdowns beyond its control, the Advisor shall take reasonable steps to minimize service interruptions but shall have no liability with respect thereto.

verbatim_text: Investment advice, only related to securities shall fall under the purview of SEBI. title: Fee Limit Compliance

required_action: Ensure fees charged do not exceed the maximum limit as per SEBI/IAASB guidelines.
evidence: Fee charge documentation and client acknowledgment of fee limits.
verbatim_text: The fee charged by IA to the client will be subject to the maximum of amount prescribed by SEBI/Investment Adviser Administration and Supervisory Body (IAASB) from time to time (applicable only for Individual and HUF Clients). Reference: Circular No. SEBI/HO/MIRSD/MIRSD-PoD/P/CIR/2025/19 dated February 17, 2025 (i) The current fee limit under Fixed Fee mode is Rs 1,51,000/- per annum per family of client. Under Assets under Advice (AUA) mode, maximum fee limit is 2.5 per cent of AUA per annum per family of client. (ii) The IA may change the fee mode at any time with the client’s consent; however, the maximum fee limit in such cases shall be higher of fee limit under the fixed fee mode or 2.5 per cent of AUA per annum per family of client. (iii) The fee limits do not include statutory charges. (iv) The fee limits apply only for investment advice related to securities under purview of SEBI. (v) The fee limits do not apply to a non-individual client / accredited investor.

required_action: Do not act on any advice received through repeated phone calls or messages without further verification.

required_action: Do not act on any limited period discounts or incentives without further verification.

verbatim_text: Don’t rush into making investments that do not match your risk taking appetite and investment goals.

summary: Investors must not share their login credentials for trading, demat or bank accounts with an Investment Adviser.
